messages.subject: First Evaluation Reminder
messages.body_plain:
Hello Students and Mentors,

I would like to remind all mentors and students who have not yet completed the evaluations to complete them ASAP.

We have less than two days remaining to complete the First Evaluations. It is important to complete these on time. If they are not done on time, students would not receive stipend and can not continue in the program. The R organization would also be penalized for this and may not get selected for next year or may receive fewer spots.

Google's deadlines are firm. The evaluation must be filled out by the student, and by one mentor from your mentor team. If the Evaluating Mentor is not available, one of the other mentors must complete the evaluation. If you need help with this, please contact the org admins as soon as possible.

Best wishes,

Narayani
for R Project Org Admins
